description: Read the click analytics of one link: total clicks, a daily series, and breakdowns by country, device, operating system, browser and referrer. Requires a ShareCut API key (Business plan).

days.description: How many days of the daily series to return. Default 30.

link.description: The link, given either as its short code (the part after sharecut.site/) or as the id returned when it was created. A full ShareCut URL is accepted too.

name: get_link_analytics
title: Get link analytics
